logging.configuration: dbt Fusion default text logging; no DBT_* logging overrides; dbt_project.yml send_anonymous_usage_stats=false
logging.color: pipe streams carry no ANSI; terminal (PTY) stdout carries ANSI + CRLF

capture_method: Each case ran as one child process with stdout and stderr redirected to separate files; exit status written to a separate file. Pipe cases use plain redirection. The terminal case runs under a PTY via macOS `script -q /dev/null`, with only stderr redirected to a file so stdout sees a TTY.
stream_note: Unlike the earlier captures/fusion/ set, Fusion 2.0.0-preview.218 writes the 'Errors and Warnings' diagnostic block to stderr. test-warning and build-larger-terminal produced empty stderr. Raw bytes preserved; no ANSI stripping or newline normalization was applied.

runs.label: run-no-selection
runs.notes: stderr holds the full Errors and Warnings block (NoNodesForSelectionCriteria dbt1092, NoNodesSelected dbt1601) while stdout carries the short completion summary.

runs.label: build-mixed-skip
runs.case: mixed build outcomes: 22 success, 1 database error, 1 skipped downstream model
runs.notes: case_mixed_broken fails with a DuckDB Binder Error; case_mixed_downstream is Skipped; base models and all base tests pass. Summary line: 24 total | 22 success | 1 error | 1 skipped.

runs.label: test-warning
runs.case: warning with successful completion (configured warn_if, exit 0)
runs.shell_spelling: uv run --locked dbt test --vars '{case_warn: true}' --select case_warn
runs.notes: Singular test case_warn configured warn_if='>0', error_if='>100'. stdout shows 'Warned' result and 'Finished test with 1 warning'; stderr empty.

runs.label: run-db-error
runs.case: database execution error during run (not a test failure)
runs.shell_spelling: uv run --locked dbt run --vars '{case_db_error: true}' --select case_db_error
runs.notes: DbDriverFailed (dbt1308) with Binder Error, candidate bindings, SQL LINE excerpt and source location in stderr.

runs.label: run-compile-error
runs.case: compile/render error during run (not a test failure)
runs.shell_spelling: uv run --locked dbt run --vars '{case_compile_error: true}' --select case_compile_error
runs.notes: JinjaError (dbt1501) unknown macro with file:line location in stderr.

runs.label: build-larger-terminal
runs.case: larger/noisier run: 14 models + 20 tests under a PTY (ANSI + CRLF)
runs.shell_spelling: script -q /dev/null sh -c "cd dbt-test && uv run --locked dbt build --vars '{case_larger: true}' 2> build-larger-terminal.stderr.txt"; echo $? > build-larger-terminal.exit.txt
runs.notes: stdout is a raw PTY stream: ANSI SGR sequences and CRLF line endings, plus a leading PTY artifact. Summary: 34 total | 34 success. stderr empty.
